package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for sort_or_filter_whitelist_logic_duplicated_across_handlers: Repeated client-field whitelist logic across endpoints.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

var allowedSortFields = map[string]bool{"name": true, "created_at": true, "status": true}

func ListUsersHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	sort := c.DefaultQuery("sort", "name")
	if !allowedSortFields[sort] {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "invalid sort field"})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"sort": sort})
}

func ListOrdersHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	sort := c.DefaultQuery("sort", "name")
	if !allowedSortFields[sort] {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "invalid sort field"})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"sort": sort})
}
